team_history_confirmation.statement: Original challenge data plus the 24-station V1 coverage pilot; V1 produced no model scores.
team_history_confirmation.provided_by: user in evaluation thread on 2026-11-08; V1 quality artifact bound below
team_history_confirmation.scope: All challenge IDs/names/locations and ALL 24 V1 selected IDs/names/locations are excluded, with the same 100km buffer, irrespective of V1 eligibility.

design.selection: SHA256(protostar-external-v2|station_id), first eight in each stratum
design.station_network: USW prefix only (WBAN network, often airport stations; not all stations are airports)
design.inventory: each of TMAX,TMIN,PRCP begins by 1950 and ends no earlier than 2018
design.cdd: sum(max((TMAX+TMIN)/2 - 65 F, 0)) over paired valid days
design.quality: nonempty QFLAG invalid; temperature outside [-130,140] F invalid; negative PRCP invalid; TMAX<TMIN invalidates both
design.trace: PRCP measurement flag T with numeric zero is valid; count recorded
design.missing: full calendar reindex; totals require at least one valid day
design.station_history: one station ID; physical moves/changes unknown; segment/change fields null

eligibility.metric_validity: official per-variable missing counts <=10 and finite value

design.limitation: Current archive QC and revisions; single-station aggregation is not the challenge city composite. Supplementary geographic generalization, never private-answer-key validation or rank.

analysis_rules: No model, hyperparameter or station replacement selected from new holdout scores.
Report every preregistered method, exclusions and failures; primary result is nested irrespective of sign.
Do not alter submission.csv or retrain the official 2019-2025 entry from holdout results.
New station labels supplement geographic validation only; historical challenge-city evidence remains reused.
2012-2018 new-station targets are opened only after this source/selection protocol is frozen; after first opening they are no longer untouched.
All observation requests must end at2018-12-31; no full-history station files/tarballs permitted.
Current-archive QC/revisions, regional dependence, station movement uncertainty and station-versus-city aggregation remain limitations.
V1 is a failed coverage pilot with no scores; report its failure alongside V2. V2 does not reuse any of the 24 V1 selected stations, names or locations within 100km.
V2 is a single metadata/missingness-motivated amendment. No model changes, score-based station replacements or repeated cohort search after V2 labels are opened.

amendment.reason: V1 failed the preregistered minimum coverage gate: 5 of 24 selected stations eligible versus a minimum of 12. No scores were computed. A new unused metadata-selected USW cohort (WBAN network, often but not universally airport stations) and 8 stations per stratum increase the chance of usable coverage; no quality thresholds are relaxed. The structural inventory pools have at least 13 candidates in each stratum after all exclusions. Selection uses only station metadata, inventory periods and the observed V1 missingness failure, with no model-performance information or score-based replacements.

source_pin_amendment.reason: A concurrent thread changed the non-model cleaning utility src/protostar_challenge/cleaning.py after V1. V2 binds the present source snapshot; model and evaluation source files are unchanged.
